extraction.summary_en: This filing (deposited 28/03/2017) records the président of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES formalising, on 21 February 2017, the realisation of a share buyback-and-cancellation capital decrease that had been authorised by the AGE of 19 January 2017 (max 150,861 EUR, price 2.72 EUR/share, 20-day creditor opposition period expired 14/02/2017 with no opposition). The capital was reduced from 368,102 EUR to 217,241 EUR by cancelling 150,861 shares bought back from four investment funds (FPCI SECURITE, FIP GALIA PME 4, GALIA VENTURE, FPCI FINANCIERE DE BRIENNE). The filing also includes the CAC's report on the reduction and the updated statutes, whose 'Apports' history article restates prior capital increases (2005, 2006, 2008 x2) and whose Article 7 now shows the 217,241 EUR capital entirely held by HADEAN, holder of category-A preference shares.

events.mechanism: rachat et annulation d'actions (L.225-207 C.com), price 2,72 EUR/action of 1 EUR nominal, following AGE authorization of 19/01/2017 and expiry of the 20-day creditor opposition period on 14/02/2017.

evidence.quote_fr: Le Président arrête le montant des actions rachetées par la Société à 150 861 et fixe la liste des associés concernés comme suit : [...] Les actions rachetées sont annulées à compter de ce jour. En conséquence, le Président constate que le capital social est réduit de 150 861 euros pour être ramené de 368 102 euros à 217 241 euros et divisé en 217 241 actions de 1 euro de valeur nominale chacune.

events.gloss_en: Capital reduced by 150,861 EUR (from 368,102 to 217,241 EUR) via buyback-and-cancellation of 150,861 shares from four fund shareholders, completed by président's decision of 21/02/2017 after AGE authorization of 19/01/2017.
events.notes: Shares bought back and cancelled: FPCI SECURITE 64,655; FIP GALIA PME 4 12,931; GALIA VENTURE 30,172; FPCI FINANCIERE DE BRIENNE 43,103 (total 150,861, matching the amount authorized). The AGE decision of 19/01/2017 was 'decided pending realisation' but this filing's updated statutes show it fully realised, hence status completed_here.

evidence.quote_fr: ARTICLE 7 - CAPITAL SOCIAL Le capital social est fixé à la somme de 217 241 euros. Il est divisé en 217 241 actions de 1 euro chacune entièrement libérées, intégralement détenues par la société HADEAN, titulaire d'actions de préférence de catégorie A.

issues: The par-value split of 27/06/2008 (division of nominal value by 100, 2,000 -> 200,000 actions of 1 EUR) changes neither capital nor holders' percentages; recorded as a snapshot only, no event emitted, per instructions.

The four buyback counterparties (FPCI SECURITE, FIP GALIA PME 4, GALIA VENTURE, FPCI FINANCIERE DE BRIENNE) are named as sellers of the cancelled shares, but the document does not explicitly state whether this extinguished their entire shareholding (though the post-transaction statutes show 100% held by HADEAN, implying these four are no longer shareholders); no explicit SHAREHOLDER_END statement is made, so none is emitted here per the no-guessing rule — left for downstream cap-table diffing.
Method (numeraire / apport en nature / incorporation de reserves) is not stated for the historic 2005, 2006 and 2008 capital increases recalled in the Apports article; left null.
